merge into T_MDM_VULCANIZING_MACH_STATUS a USING (
SELECT #{item.id, jdbcType=DOUBLE} id, #{item.factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} factory_code,#{item.year, jdbcType=DECIMAL} year,#{item.month, jdbcType=DECIMAL} month, #{item.vulcanizingMachineId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} VULCANIZING_MACHINE_ID, #{item.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} status,#{item.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} remark, #{item.isDelete, jdbcType=DOUBLE} is_delete, #{item.createTime, jdbcType=DATE} create_time, #{item.updateTime, jdbcType=DATE} update_time, #{item.createBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} create_by, #{item.updateBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} update_by from dual
) b ON ( a.year = b.year and a.month = b.month and a.FACTORY_CODE = b.FACTORY_CODE and a.VULCANIZING_MACHINE_ID = b.VULCANIZING_MACHINE_ID and a.is_delete = 0 ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE
a.UPDATE_TIME = now(), a.status = b.status, a.remark = b.remark, a.update_by = b.create_by
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( a.ID, a.FACTORY_CODE, a.YEAR, a.MONTH, a.VULCANIZING_MACHINE_ID, a.STATUS, a.REMARK, a.IS_DELETE, a.CREATE_TIME, a.CREATE_BY ) values( VULCANIZING_MACH_STATUS_SEQ.nextval, b.FACTORY_CODE, b.YEAR, b.MONTH, b.VULCANIZING_MACHINE_ID, b.STATUS, b.REMARK, b.IS_DELETE, b.CREATE_TIME, b.CREATE_BY )
